description: Follow reviewed parents of a City id, immediate parent first. Returns a canonical list with coverage:partial; an empty list does not prove the city has no administrative parent.

deep.description: Legacy profile request flag. API 2.1 paid plans include profile detail automatically. Existing access rules and explicit metered operations remain unchanged.

hierarchy.description: Include reviewed grain and immediate parent summary, or null when unknown. Requires foundation readiness; otherwise 503.

id.description: Stable City id selected from a lookup or search.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

romanized.description: Include a reviewed official romanized name and its language. No ASCII-folding fallback; missing or conflicting forms are null.
